actions.action: Commit row outcomes with replay-safe batch checkpoints
actions.mechanism: Atomic batches couple accepted writes, row outcomes, and progress so retries cannot duplicate committed work.
actions.implementation: Uniquely identify outcomes by tenant, file digest, and source line. Transactionally commit outcomes, target writes, and record-boundary checkpoints. Reject conflicting natural keys explicitly.
actions.check: Disconnect before and after commits; replay repeatedly. Verify identical target contents, one outcome per row, and no checkpoint beyond committed work.
actions.risk: Concurrent imports require database-enforced natural-key uniqueness.

actions.action: Quarantine invalid rows with actionable rejection reports
actions.mechanism: Explicit validation and isolated constraint failures preserve valid rows without coercing invalid references.
actions.implementation: Record source line, natural key, field, rejected value, and error code. Roll back and bisect failed batches to isolate row errors; retry infrastructure failures separately.
actions.check: Mix valid rows, missing references, and concurrent reference deletions. Verify valid rows commit and every rejection identifies its cause without substituted values.
actions.risk: Rejection reports need access controls and sensitive-value redaction.

actions.action: Separate resumable upload from bounded-memory processing
actions.mechanism: A finite durable spool survives connection loss and decouples upload rate from database processing.
actions.implementation: Persist upload offsets and chunk checksums; verify the supplied digest before import. Enforce spool quotas, backpressure, and a 96 MB worker limit; stream CSV with bounded records.
actions.check: Interrupt a 4 GB upload, exhaust spool capacity, and submit oversized records. Verify resumability, explicit errors, digest verification, and peak memory below 128 MB.
actions.risk: Finite storage requires expiration and cleanup; sustained overload still needs admission control.

actions.action: Publish partial status and reconcile linked corrections
actions.mechanism: A durable outcome ledger distinguishes incomplete processing from completed partial acceptance and tracks subsequent repairs.
actions.implementation: At verified EOF, reconcile parsed records against accepted and rejected outcomes. Publish counts and partial status. Link corrected submissions to original rejection IDs; retain history.
actions.check: Verify accepted plus rejected equals parsed records, accepted outcomes match target writes, and corrected rows resolve only their linked rejections. Interrupted parsing must remain incomplete.
actions.risk: Do not report complete reconciliation when malformed CSV prevents reliable record boundaries.
